text:
sofia: quick sync request — we need a concrete list of runtime + infra signals for the new unit-econ dashboard (1k-token cost, cache/batch savings breakdowns). who owns what? :wave:
jamal: +1. can we be specific about cardinality and aggregation windows? product needs per-customer and global 1h/24h rollups. 
anya: runtime can emit the low-level bits. plan to push these prometheus metrics from the inference runtime: `tokens_in_total`, `tokens_out_total`, `batch_size_histogram`, `kv_cache_lookup_total`, `kv_cache_hit_total`, `kv_cache_bytes_cached`, `gpu_seconds_total`. tags: `model`, `variant`, `quant`, `region`, `customer_id` (when in dedicated/private).
sofia: nice. product also wants a derived metric: `cost_per_1k_tokens` with cache+batch savings shown as a stacked breakdown. how do we get cost info? 
mike_r: infra will supply cost rates per GPU-hour and per-region egress. we can export `gpu_price_per_second{instance="p4d"}` as a static metric that the dashboard joins on region+instance. for ephemeral preemptible instances, add `spot=true` label.
jamal: join on model -> model_size mapping too. different variants (fp16, int8) have different throughput and effective token cost. we should include `exec_latency_p50/p95` to show perf tradeoffs.
talia: for analytics: want one row per request with these fields to run offline recon: `request_id,ts,customer_id,model,variant,tokens_in,tokens_out,cache_hits,cache_lookups,batch_size,gpu_seconds,route_policy` — can you emit that to kinesis or direct bigquery?
anya: we can emit a compact JSON event for each *served* request (sampling optional) to the events pipeline: `{request_id, ts, model, variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_hit, batch_size, gpu_secs}`. sampling at 1% by default to control volume. will add a route_policy label from the router.
jamal: constraints: metrics + events must allow aggregation into per-1k token unit. two pitfalls we saw before: double-counting cached prefixes and inflated batching savings when clients do short bursts. we need clear semantics: `kv_cache_hit` must be exclusive (one lookup per prefix attempt) and `tokens_out` should reflect tokens emitted to client after padding.
sofia: UX asks: console should show both estimated raw cost (gpu+egress) and a "savings" panel showing % reduction attributed to cache and batching. also want a slider to toggle aggregation window and a per-customer toggle.
mike_r: operational note: tag cardinality risk — `customer_id` on prometheus counters is bad. keep per-customer in events/BQ, not Prom. Prom metrics should carry `tenant_type` (hosted/dedicated/private) and `customer_bucket` (low/med/high) instead.
anya: agreed. runtime will push detailed per-request events to events stream and low-card Prom counters with `model,variant,region,tenant_type` labels. also will add `batch_size_summary_{min,max,avg}` gauges per worker.
talia: product analytics will own the derived pipeline that computes `cost_per_1k_tokens`, `cache_savings_percent`, `effective_throughput` and publish to the dashboard dataset. will sketch the SQL and share by EOD.
sofia: owners recap — runtime/anya emits events + prom, infra/mike provides cost rates and static metrics, eng-platform/jamal exposes joins and dashboard queries, analytics/talia builds derived dataset. deadline: first prototype dashboard by next Wed. :calendar:
jamal: action item for me: write telemetry contract doc (prom metric names, event JSON schema, label conventions) and PR it to infra/rfcs. ping me for quick review.
anya: will add sampling config and a small example producer in the runtime repo. example event JSON in thread: `{\"request_id\":\"r123\",\"ts\":1912345678,\"model\":\"rwkv-70b\",\"variant\":\"int8\",\"tokens_in\":120,\"tokens_out\":300,\"cache_hit\":true,\"batch_size\":8,\"gpu_secs\":0.02}`
mike_r: I'll add `gpu_price_per_second` exporter and a nightly job to snapshot price history for backfills. also will add `preemptible:true/false` label.
talia: thanks — once we have the event schema i'll build the BigQuery table and the SQL for per-1k calculations (include windowing note). should we also store `route_policy` to break down cost by routing decisions?
sofia: yes store `route_policy` (latency-optimized/cost-optimized/fallback) so product can show where decisions cause cost delta.
devinfra-bot: deploy 1912345689: runtime/telemetry v0.3 promoted to staging (metrics + request-event emitter enabled for staging).
sofia: perfect — i'll coordinate with design for the savings breakdown visuals. will follow up with an RFC link once jamal posts the contract. :thumbsup:
jamal: posting draft contract in #rfc-infra tonight. please review. closing loop here unless blockers show up. :eyes:
